verses.english: “When a foolish, incompetent untrue person has three qualities they keep themselves broken and damaged. …

verses.pali: asucinā kāyakammena, asucinā vacīkammena, asucinā manokammena …pe….
verses.english: Impure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …
When an astute, competent true person has three qualities they keep themselves intact and unscathed. …

verses.pali: sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena—
verses.english: Pure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṁ anupahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṁ, bahuñca puññaṁ pasavatī”ti.
